task: find visibly mounted populated circuitry within a single identifiable unit
population: 40 candidates per arm from 392 eligible unseen images in mixed-scene parent group
reviewer: one AI agent inspecting 28 blind sheets; native images rechecked for nine initial ambiguities

label_meanings.M: populated circuitry visibly mounted within one identifiable device
label_meanings.X: exposed populated board, but detached or in a multi-item scene
label_meanings.N: no populated board resolved at review scale
label_meanings.U: relation unresolved even after native-size review

interpretation_limits: Subgroup 3 was chosen after inspecting earlier development labels; no independent hypothesis test.
All methods used the same parent scene group and equal 40-image review capacity.
Selections overlap, so arm counts are descriptive and must not be treated as independent binomial trials.
The 392-image eligible pool lacks complete mounted-board labels; recall cannot be calculated.
A single AI reviewer is not an independent human or operator evaluation.
Near-duplicate grouping used known phash<=5 links; the near-duplicate list may be incomplete.
